description: Writes the finished webinar texts for a session that is ready: title, invitation email, reminders and the registration copy. Side effect: it starts a text-generation job on the connector (about a minute) and stores the result in the session; nothing is published to a WordPress site and no email is sent to anyone. Needs `session_id`. A second call with the returned `job_id` reads the job's state until the texts are there. Optional: `invite_type` for one of the eight built-in channels, `type="custom"` with `custom_channel` for any other channel, `direction` for an angle or `skip_direction` for none.

custom_channel.description: Only with this call and type="custom": the exact name of the channel or format the invitation is for when it is not one of the eight built-in platforms — e.g. Xing, WeChat, Line, KakaoTalk, Viber, Threads, Mastodon, a guest article, or the host's own format. The text is then written for exactly this channel, not for a built-in platform.

direction.description: Optional with this call: the angle/framing of the invitation (natural language), e.g. 'Zeitersparnis und Skalierung ohne neue Mitarbeiter' for an agency. If missing, the invitation is written at once without a special angle.

invite_type.description: Only with this call, when the invitation is for a specific platform: list = email list, personal = personal message, facebook = Facebook post, whatsapp = WhatsApp status, instagram = Instagram post, linkedin = LinkedIn post, telegram = Telegram channel, youtube = YouTube post.

job_id.description: the job number from an earlier call, to check whether the texts are ready. Without job_id a new job is started; only one text job runs at a time.

language.description: The language the host writes in.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

skip_direction.description: true when the host wants NO special angle — then it generates without an angle.

type.description: invites (default), starter, or custom. custom = the invitation is for a channel that is NOT one of the eight built-in platforms — pass the channel name in custom_channel. A channel outside the eight built-ins is written as custom, not as one of the eight.

name: wi_write_webinar_invitation_emails
title: Write the webinar texts
